about.title: About me
about.text: With 4+ years of experience in React and React Native, I build fast, pixel-perfect products end to end, and I lean on AI tools like Claude Code every day to ship faster without cutting corners. Let's build something great together.

okda.name: OKDA — Audiovisual Production Company
okda.description: Institutional landing page for OKDA, an Argentine audiovisual production company specialized in strategic communication for businesses and brands. Animated hero, value proposition, team, services, process, video gallery, and contact sections.

florencia.name: Ski Instructor Website
florencia.description: Booking management platform for a ski instructor, with multilanguage support and responsive design. Clients check availability on a calendar and submit requests; the admin panel manages every reservation. Backend powered by Supabase.

tenedores.name: 5Tenedores
tenedores.description: Mobile restaurant discovery app built with React Native and Expo. Users browse restaurants with Google Maps locations, leave reviews and ratings, and check a ranking; auth and data persisted with Firebase.

snap.name: Snap — URL Shortener
snap.description: Full-stack URL shortener with an analytics dashboard, JWT auth, 70 integration tests, and Playwright E2E tests.

calorie_tracker.name: Calorie Tracker
calorie_tracker.description: Calorie counter built with React and Vite, using useReducer for state management.

tip_calculator.name: Tip Calculator
tip_calculator.description: Web tip calculator with real-time split calculations.

guitarla.name: GuitarLA
guitarla.description: E-commerce shopping cart for guitar products with persistent state.

bullets: Shipped cross-platform React Native features for La Anónima (major Argentine supermarket chain) and Farmacity (leading Argentine pharmacy chain), applying clean architecture to keep both codebases scalable.
Drove daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews with designers, backend engineers, and QA, catching integration issues before release.

Owned the frontend of an internal AI innovation initiative end-to-end as the sole frontend developer, building a React + Vite MVP and integrating the Gemini and Claude APIs into core product features.
Coordinated App Store and Google Play submissions alongside the mobile team, preparing builds to avoid release delays.
Built and shipped features in React Native (Expo) for ClaroPay, a widely used virtual wallet app for Claro customers in Argentina.
Increased user engagement and streamlined in-app navigation by implementing push notifications and deep linking.
Set up GitHub Actions and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and introduced SonarQube quality gates, catching code issues before merge.
Maintained and fixed bugs in the React.js-based CMS powering ClaroPay's content and configuration, enabling content updates without new app releases.
Built interactive, mobile-optimized interfaces in React Native, prioritizing smooth UX and performance.
Secured core app functionality and user data by integrating Firebase for authentication and data storage.
Kept the app stable through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting, resolving issues before they affected users.
Shaped architecture decisions with the team and upheld code quality through peer reviews.
Built new features across frontend (React Native, React.js) and backend (Node.js) for Regatta Fitness, a fitness app that reached 10,000+ downloads.
Increased content sharing by integrating the GetSocial library for social media sharing functionality.
Maintained production apps built with JavaScript and TypeScript, resolving issues to keep them stable for end users.
